evidence.quote: Plasma was isolated on days 0, 1, 3, 7, and 14 after vaccination and analyzed for concentration levels of interleukin-2 (IL-2), IL-6, IL-12 p70, IL-10, interleukin-1 receptor antagonist (IL-1RA), interferon-γ (IFN-γ), IFN-α, tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-α), TNF-β, macrophage-inflammatory protein-1α (MIP-1α), MIP-1β, monocyte-chemoattractant protein-1 (MCP-1) and IP-10 using a Luminex assay.
PBMC samples were frozen in liquid nitrogen, thawed, stained, and acquired on an LSR Fortessa flow cytometer.

GP-specific antibody responses were measured using an ELISA in two centralized laboratories (Marburg, Germany and United States Army Medical Research Institute for Infectious Diseases [USAMRIID], USA) on days 0, 7, 14, 28, 56, 84, and 180.
Diluted libraries were multiplex-sequenced on the Illumina HiSeq 2500 instrument (single read, 50-bp run).
